title: GT3037 / GT3076 Turbocharger (T3 Flange, V-Band, 0.82 A/R)
description: Designed for responsive power delivery on mid-sized displacement engines, this GT3076-style unit is built to support up to 500 horsepower. It runs a 52.7mm inducer / 76mm exducer compressor wheel paired with a 0.60 A/R housing, delivering roughly 45–50 lb/min of airflow. The larger 0.82 A/R exhaust housing on a standard T3 flange reduces backpressure at higher RPMs, making it a great match for 2.5L to 3.0L engines looking to hold boost cleanly through the top of the powerband. On a typical 2.5L build, expect fast boost ramp-up starting around 3,400 to 3,700 RPM. It includes water and oil cooling ports to extend journal bearing life, along with a rear V-band discharge for easy downpipe alignment and fabrication.
